label: LAN party or tournament
summary: Event info and brackets only the orga posts in, match rooms per team, casters, a help desk and an orga room.
notes: Posting in an announcement channel takes an admin (the admin token) or, on a server with accounts, a moderator.
Teams can open more rooms with +; for a big event raise max_channels in server_settings.json.
Need more matches at once? Copy a pair of Match rooms and number them on.

channels.name: info

channels.description: Brackets, results and who plays next. Only the orga posts here.
